definitions.explanation: At a right angle to a horizontal surface or to another line.

examples.japanese: {垂直|すいちょく}に{落|お}ちる。
この{二|ふた}つの{線|せん}は{垂直|すいちょく}に{交|まじ}わる。
examples.english: These two lines intersect at right angles.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}は{地面|じめん}に{垂直|すいちょく}に{立|た}っている。
examples.english: The wall stands perpendicular to the ground.

notes:
{垂直|すいちょく} means vertical (straight up and down) or perpendicular (at a 90-degree angle to something). Can function as a noun or na-adjective.

FORMS:
- {垂直|すいちょく}な/の + noun: vertical ~
- {垂直|すいちょく}に: vertically

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {垂直|すいちょく}に{立|た}つ: to stand vertically
- {垂直|すいちょく}{方向|ほうこう}: vertical direction
- {垂直|すいちょく}{離着陸|りちゃくりく}: vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL)
- {垂直|すいちょく}{落下|らっか}: vertical drop/free fall

CONTRAST:
- {垂直|すいちょく}: vertical/perpendicular
- {水平|すいへい}: horizontal/level
- {平行|へいこう}: parallel
- {斜|なな}め: diagonal, slanted
